test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which Grand Slam tournament was played between 17 to 30 January 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Australian Open.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Australian Open** took place **at Melbourne Park, Australia** from **17 to 30 January 2022****.**
 
• It was the **110th edition **of the Australian Open and the first Grand Slam of the year.
 
• The **men’s singles** title was **won by Rafael Nadal,** who won his **21st major title** and **his second Australian Open**.
 
• The **women’s singles** title was won by **Ashleigh Barty**, who won **her first Australian Open title** and third major title.
 
• Barty was the first Australian to win the title since **Chris O’Neil won the title in 1978****.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Details of the other Grand Slam tournaments of 2022**

 
• 
 
**French Open**:

 
 
• The French Open was held at the **Stade Roland Garros in Paris, France, **from **22 May to 5 June 2022**.
 
• It was the **126th edition **of the French Open and the second Grand Slam event of 2022.
 
• The **men’s singles title** was won for the **14th time by Rafael Nadal**, who won his **22nd Grand Slam title****.**
 
• The **women’s singles title **was won by **Iga Świątek,** who won **her second French Open** and second grand slam title, having won her first at the 2020 French Open.
 
 
 
• 
 
**Wimbledon**:

 
 
• Wimbledon took place at the **All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club in Wimbledon, London, United Kingdom** from **27 June to 10 July 2022****.**
 
• It was the** 135th edition** of Wimbledon and the third Grand Slam tournament of the year.
 
• **Novak Djokovic **successfully defended his gentlemen’s singles title to claim his** 21st major title**, defeating Nick Kyrgios in the final.
 
• The l**adies’ singles title **was won by **Elena Rybakina**, who defeated Ons Jabeur in the final.
 
 
 
• 
 
**US Open**:

 
 
• The US Open took place at the **USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center in New York** City from **August 29 – September 11, 2022**.
 
• It was the **142nd edition **of tennis’ US Open and the fourth and final tennis major (Grand Slam event) of the year.
 
• **Carlos Alcaraz and Iga Świątek** won the **men’s and women’s singles titles**, respectively.
 
• **Carlos** became the** first male player from the 2000s** (born in 2003) and **Iga** became the** second female player from the 2000s** (born in 2001), to win the tournament’s singles titles.
 
 

81
